info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-Create Careers Applications Offer-v1-spec
info.description: The Batch Insertion Careers Applications Offer API enables businesses to efficiently process multiple career application offers in a single request. This API is designed for recruitment platforms and HR systems that need to streamline the workflow of managing job offers for candidates. By facilitating batch insertions, it minimizes manual efforts and enhances operational efficiency. Typical consumers include HR professionals and recruitment teams looking to automate their application management processes.

post.summary: Creates a new offer for an application.
post.description: This endpoint allows you to create a new offer associated with a specific application. It requires the relevant details about the offer to be included in the request body. Upon successful creation, a confirmation response will be provided, detailing the newly created offer.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to create a new offer application. Please ensure all required fields are provided in the JSON format.
